title: Molten Mediterranean Blackeye Pea Paella
description: A kid-friendly, Mediterranean dish featuring blackeye peas, with a unique molten twist, this paella is perfect for a fun and flavorful dinner. It combines the richness of Mediterranean spices with the comfort of a warm, cheesy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the uncooked white rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is coated in the spice mixture.
Add the chicken broth, blackeye peas, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the shredded mozzarella cheese until it is melted and the paella is molten.
Let the paella rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
